[font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][i][b][size=6]About[/size][/b][/i][/color][/font][/color][/font][font=Tahoma]
[size=2]I reshaded and edited the sprites that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55537262?tab=user+files]6480[/url] made for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5263]More Giant Crops[/url] mod to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4912]cometkins Better Crops and Foraging  [/url]﻿color scheme / aesthetic.
You do [b][i]NOT[/i] [/b]need to download 6480's mod for mine to work.
[/size][/font][/size][/font][font=Tahoma]

[/size][/b][/i][list=1]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=2] Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ ( [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]click for instructions[/url]﻿﻿﻿)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=2][b][i][u]MANUALLY[/u][/i] INSTALL[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5263]More Giant Crops[/url]: download, unzip and put it into your  [b]/Programs (x86) /steam /steamapps /common /Stardew Valley /Mods[/b] Folder [/size][/font]
[font=Tahoma][size=2][color=#e06666][b](do [i]not[/i] install with vortex or mo2, or else [i]you will not find the folder[/i].)[/b][/color]
[/size][/font]

[font=Tahoma][color=#e06666][size=2][b](if a folder is missing, you can just make it yourself, no problem.)[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[b]
[/b]to uninstall, remove more giant crops from your mods folder, since it will not be managed by your mod manager of choice.
